property_summary: For any call to transferOwnership, the original contract ensures the owner can never be the zero address, while the buggy version allows setting the zero address as owner.
In the reference contract, transferring ownership to the zero address is impossible (the call always reverts), but the buggy version allows it, so the owner can become address(0).
After any call to transferOwnership, the reference C ensures the owner is never the zero address, while the buggy version allows the zero address to become owner.
